2. Heard the arguments of learned counsel for petitioner and learned HCGP for the State and respondent No.2, served and absent.

The case of the prosecution is that on the complaint of the mother of the victim Lakshmi/respondent No.2 lodged complaint on 19.3.2023 alleging that the victim/daughter, aged about 17 years had left from the house of her elder sister, Padmavathi and on 11.3.2023 she left the home, but did not return.
Thereafter, she searched all the house of relatives but could not find.
Therefore, she lodged the complaint suspecting that the petitioner might have abducted her.
The police after registering the FIR initially case was registered for 366A of IPC and subsequently on 12.12.2022 the police rescued the victim and arrested the petitioner from Mumbai.
Then on 14.12.2022, the petitioner was remanded to the judicial custody.
His bail petition came to be rejected, hence he is before this court.

4. Having heard the arguments and perused the records, on perusal of the same, which reveals, as per the statement of the victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim was having affair with the petitioner since NC: 2023:KHC-K:8601 21.1.2021.

sentences.text: On 11.3.2022, the victim went out of the house at 2.30 p.m., and did not return back.
Subsequently, complaint came to be lodged.
The statement of the victim girl under Section 164 Cr.P.C. reveals both of them went to Mumbai to the house of the sister of the accused/petitioner and they stayed in their house.
The accused said to have sexually assaulted her.
Subsequently, they have taken rented house, both of them stayed together for 9 months.
Subsequently, on 12.12.2022 the police apprehended the accused and rescued the victim.
The investigation is completed and charge sheet has been filed and the victim was staying with the accused for almost 9 months and there was love affair between them.
The age of the victim was 17 years, 8 months and 4 days as on the date of the incident.
Now she is yet to attain the majority.
The petitioner is in custody for almost 11 months.
Investigation is completed NC: 2023:KHC-K:8601 long back and charge sheet has been filed.
Therefore, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, by imposing certain conditions if bail is granted, no prejudice would cause to the prosecution case.

Hence, the following order:
Order Accordingly,. Criminal petition is allowed.
